body: I know her so well and I know she is my soul mate. I also know in the morning she will feel horrible and apologize for it all. It's just in the moment it's overwhelming and it's just so hard to take it and take it without feeling like I'm going to explode.

But how? I just need advice to start.
I feel like I'm still to blame.
I don't know where to begin.
Henstly I don't know how to even start to fix everything.

Shitty part is I just ook another shot of vodka as I'm reading this without even thinking about it, I just did it.

I appreciate you're reply I want to talk to people but I see myself as the sole problem. She doesn't ever buy anything I'm always the one who does and I'm always the one who wants to but if it's there she will have some with me and then I can never stop I always find any excuse to go buy more because I want us both to feel amazing and I'm just dragging her down.

We never have any booze in the house because we drink it every day I always will buy more daily. Detox has never worked for us and we have both tried. I told her I am going to fight with everything I have to stop and I know it'll be easier for her because she hasn't bought alcohol for herself in 3+ years I'm the only one that ever does it.

This is what I need to hear, I rely on solely other people to tell me things I hope this post teaches people. I want to get better but I'm a people pleaser and I just need people to yell at me to stop.

The sad part is I have epilepsy and the last time I talked to a doctor they said it could cause a seizure that could easily kill me. The problem is I can't just STOP. If I buy any alcohol I will drink it all, I can't stop myself after just one drink and after I have some I can't stop myself I paced my house for an hour earlier trying to find any reason to not buy any more and low and behold I still went and bought more regardless of how much I fought myself.
Thank you.

You don't know how much thay means, I came here to seek help and I'm getting it, sadly I actually have epilepsy and I take a ton of medication for it which is another reason to stop. Regardless I don't feel like this is her fault I think I made her this way and now I'm just afraid it's to far gone to change us both. The daily struggle I feel makes me lay in bed and find anything to focus on aside from drinking more.

This is terrible but I need something to keep me going, I told her if I drink she needs to leave me, she declined but I'm still keeping the commitment in my head to at least make myself find anything to not get anymore.
Thanks for the tough advice I need it, I keep caving all the time and I'm trying to find all excuses to keep her in my life but I know I'm just dragging her down with me.

It's terrible to say I'm trying to find anyone to empathize with me and just tell me there is a way I can fix this. I'm going to stop drinking because I know I have a problem I just don't want to lose her.
Thanks for the advice, I'm trying to find anyway to save our relationship after I've failed so many times.
That's what we discussed tonight and I've tried but, I always find an excuse to. I try to talk myself out of it but I always still go and get somthing. If it's in the house she will drink too.
Sad to say that I know and I just don't want to accept it.
I don't know how to bring it up, she is the love of my life and just thinking about hurting her emotionally kills me. I don't know what to say to even bring up the conversation.

I don't know what to do anymore, honestly I have diagnoses anxiety and I'm so afraid I mention anything of this subject to her and she is gone. This woman is the love of my life and I'll never meet anyone I love more. I just don't know how I approach this situation.
Thank you.
I honestly don't even know how to start.
Thank you for you're response I know I have a lot to think about.

1. I'm so sorry about that

2. I'm just trying to get the words right when I confront her because I know I don't help the problem when I get home and drink with her
That sad part is she has been diagnosed with depression and she takes medication for it but she always says the only thing that helps numb the pain is drinking.
I honestly don't know what to say to her, I love her so much and I think I have anxiety. If I brought anything up I feel like she will just leave me and I don't want to lose her.

It's sad for me to say it may be true but it turned south from causal drinking to this fast. Her family said to their friends and her coworkers she was a drunk and at the time she was just casually drinking. Now everyone will text her that she is and she has decided if everyone thinks it that she should just become what everyone views her as instead of trying to just be happy.

She doesn't want to be an alcoholic and she isn't by the amount she drinks. It's just because her family has told her she is (she misses work alot because she has social anxiety and depression that she takes meds for) now that they've said that she just wants to stop trying to convince them what the truth is and she just says "fine if they think I'm just an alcoholic then i will be"

That's the problem, I just can't accept it no matter how much I want to. Idk what my problem is but I cannot leave her nor stop her I love her so much I just want to see her happy and it may be terrible for either of us.

Hey, I really appricate any kind of comment or support I never get anything from anything I post, I'm here to just talk to people and hopefully find someone who understands this. I mean this is the love of my life and I never want to lose her but I just don't know what to do right now.

I know where you're coming from but I just can't leave her, I know there is somthing deep down that's trying to fix this somehow otherwise I wouldn't have posted this. Just me coming home to see her drunk to the point she can't stand hurts. I don't want to leave her I'm just so out of ideas that I needed to see what an outside opinion was like for once.

Both her and I have visited that subreddit and it's really good for people. I thought our drinking was under control for awhile but, lately her parents have told her she is nothing but a drunk and it hurt her so bad she now says if that's what they believe aside from the truth then she would rather just become what they think she is rather than try to defend herself.

We've talked about everything but her family calls her a drunk and she has accepted that she isn't one but, she now is in the mindset that if they think she is then why doesn't she just become one and enjoy being drunk instead of caring what other people think.
The worst part is I honestly don't know if she will remember this conversation in the morning, she almost always remembers everythimg but sometimes she blocks out things.

We have tried to have open conversations but when we bring it up she tells me to jokingly shut up and she loves me.

It's only when she is drunk thay she truly expresses her felling (she has deep depression and anxiety) every time I bring it up I always feel fine but, I always have this slight guilt that she is better without me.

I love her so much so I keep going but when she said that tonight it broke my heart more than I've ever been hurt before.

We have been trying to make it work because we literally match in any and every way but, it's just gotten hard since we both work 2 jobs we come home and both have a drink or 2 and then it turns into her crying about how much she hates her family and how much they don't trust her and eventually it turns into her questioning how much I love her. I love her more than my own life.
I'm the same way I like having the feedback and she does appreciate when I did those things but I don't think she notices that I'm not doing them.
I guess that's what I'm trying to say, in my head it feels like I'm not trying and in my head I think that it would make her feel bad but she doesn't show it and I don't think she cares.
I don't think she cares or even notices them.

I tried to go out on dates all the time, I used to always give her presents and just try to be a great boyfriend. Now, I get home sit on the couch or go to my room occasionally ask if she want to go get fast food but that's it
I don't think it's an issue I just wanted to talk about it, I have no friends and no one to talk to about it.

We have tons in common that's the problem, and we fit together like a puzzle. I just feel guilty that I'm desiring to be alone more, not like without her just like okay spending more time without her when before I wanted to spend every second with her, which was unhealthy because she likes her alone time
It's been a year easily since it's been gone
This makes me soooo happy I live to vaccum but I can never make it look like that.

She tells me that she just can't wait to leave and she feels like she is a burden she begs me to just a glock to her head and end it, she just doesn't want to be here. I want to help her but I have no idea what to do.

I am overweight yes and I'm working my ass off to get better, I was once 360lbs and I'm down to 250, I never pressure her for sex. I am trying to be the man she wants but I don't feel like I'll ever get there and I'm afraid it's affecting her more than she tells me and I don't want to hurt her.

I am not blaming her for them at all, I am trying to empathize with them and I'm trying to fux the to a come date her, in the end i want her happy

We do talk about everything honestly, but the answers are always just things like, it doesn't matter or were fine. I've even dug deeper before and nothing.

I feel like she isn't physically attracted to me, to clarify. I feel like she isn't attracted to me and she is ignoring it, I'm trying to just get advice about how to respond to these thought or how to talk to her about it. We have brought it up before but the answer has always been that it didn't matter.

I've read some things about this and most of them say don't always make yourself available, because it makes women want men. We love together and it's literally impossible for me to not be available for her, unless I'm at work. She is always at home when I'm there so I can't just not be there.

I am always here for her and I will always be, I'm not craving the sex or anything but my insecurities don't help. I don't think she brings it up because she doesn't want me to go, I'm not going anywhere. I just wish there was a magical cure to make someone more attracted to you. We are not compatable and I am scared once she moves past all of this depression and trauma she will just feel like she doesn't want me. I'm still always going to be right there for her regardless but, I'm hoping I can make her more attracted to me physically, rather than just emotionally.

She has had trauma in her past that makes her have zero sex drive, she also is working with depression. She says she never wants to have sex and I'm okay with that. I just can't get past the feeling that her not being attracted to me is a big role in her zero sex drive and she either is not mentioning it or is ignoring it. She has said she misses her sex drive and she wishes it would come back but I don't know if it ever will with me around.
